import 'package:conflux/conflux.dart';

void main() {
  const Option<String?> absent = None();
  const Option<String?> cleared = Some(null);
  const Some<String?> supplied = Some('Bhaswanth');
  final String? exactValue = supplied.value;
  final Option<num> widened = const Some<int>(42);
  final Option<String> mapped = widened.map((num value) => '$value');
  final ({String name, int age}) record = const Some('Ada')
      .zipWith(const Some(37), (name, age) => (name: name, age: age))
      .getOrElse(() => (name: 'missing', age: 0));
  final values = <String?>[
    switch (absent) { Some(:final value) => value, None() => 'absent' },
    cleared.match(onSome: (value) => value, onNone: () => 'absent'),
    exactValue,
    mapped.getOrElse(() => 'missing'),
    record.name,
  ];
  if (values.join('|') != 'absent|null|Bhaswanth|42|Ada') {
    throw StateError('Incorrect Option composition: $values');
  }

  const Result<int, Never> infallible = Success(42);
  final Result<num, Object> widenedResult = infallible;
  final Result<String, String> composed = widenedResult
      .map((num value) => '$value')
      .mapError((Object error) => '$error');
  final exhaustive = switch (composed) {
    Success<String, String>(:final value) => value,
    Failure<String, String>(:final error) => error,
  };
  if (exhaustive != '42') {
    throw StateError('Incorrect Result composition: $exhaustive');
  }
  if (describeResult(composed) != 'success:42') {
    throw StateError('Generic Result pattern did not match');
  }
}

String describeResult<A, E>(Result<A, E> result) => switch (result) {
  Success<A, E>(:final value) => 'success:$value',
  Failure<A, E>(:final error) => 'failure:$error',
};
